# Urban Repair Company
> Home appliance repair service in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad), Maharashtra, India. Repairs, services and installs air conditioners; repairs washing machines, refrigerators and other home appliances at the customer's home. Same-day service, genuine spare parts, upfront pricing and a 90-day service warranty.

Address: Survey No. B-13, Mondha Naka, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad), Maharashtra
Phone: +91 95798 68696
Website: https://urbanrepaircompany.github.io/AC-Repair-Washing-Machine-Repair-Fridge-Repair-Chhatrapati-Sambhajinagar-/
